property_summary: Calling getFirstWithdrawalBonus(recipient) with the calling contract itself (which can receive Ether) when the contract has at least 100 wei succeeds on the first call, credits exactly 100 wei to the test contract, and a second call for the same recipient and sender reverts without changing the contract's Ether balance.

confirmed_difference.thread_focus: whether a call `getFirstWithdrawalBonus(args)` reverts or completes, and on which inputs
